author: v-Golubev
title: ARM64 cross-compilation build fails with cc1plus invalid-pch error on shared cmake_pch.hxx.gch
signature: cc1plus: error: cmake_pch.hxx.gch: not a PCH file [-Werror=invalid-pch]|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Build / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: OpenVINO JS API cmake re-configure/build step fails with cc1plus invalid-pch errors across 14 src/core/reference translation units

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_ubuntu_22_arm64_cross_compilation
failed_jobs.symptom: Overall status check fails because the Build job failed

key_errors: cc1plus: error: /__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/openvino_build/src/core/reference/CMakeFiles/openvino_reference.dir/cmake_pch.hxx.gch: not a PCH file [-Werror=invalid-pch]
cc1plus: all warnings being treated as errors
root_cause: The JS API build step re-invokes cmake on the SAME build directory (openvino_build) with a different configuration (-DCPACK_GENERATOR=NPM -DENABLE_SYSTEM_TBB=OFF -DENABLE_WHEEL=OFF) after the initial full ARM64 build already completed with ENABLE_FASTER_BUILD=ON (PCH enabled). The precompiled header cmake_pch.hxx.gch generated for the first configuration is reused for the second configuration without being invalidated/regenerated, so when cc1plus recompiles src/core/reference translation units for the JS API variant it finds a stale/mismatched PCH file, triggering -Werror=invalid-pch (promoted to a hard error by CMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON). This is purely a build-pipeline/cache issue; the triggering commit (PR #37717) only adds a transformations-writing-guidelines skill/docs and Copilot-instructions routing, entirely unrelated to the core/reference PCH build graph.
reproduction_steps: Not reproducible outside the exact CI matrix. Locally: configure+build the ARM64 cross-compilation target with ENABLE_FASTER_BUILD=ON, then re-run cmake on the same build directory with -DCPACK_GENERATOR=NPM -DENABLE_SYSTEM_TBB=OFF -DENABLE_WHEEL=OFF and rebuild the openvino_reference target; a stale cmake_pch.hxx.gch is expected to reproduce the same invalid-pch failure.
recommended_actions: In the ARM64 cross-compilation job (job_build_linux.yml / OpenVINO JS API build step), invalidate or regenerate cmake_pch.hxx.gch (or clear CMakeFiles/openvino_reference.dir) before the second cmake re-configure+build pass for the JS API package, or build the JS API package in its own separate build directory

Disable ENABLE_FASTER_BUILD (PCH) for the JS-API re-configure pass, or force a clean rebuild of affected targets whenever CPACK_GENERATOR/TBB/WHEEL options change between cmake invocations on the same build tree

Escalate urgently to build-system/CI owners: this is the 14th recorded recurrence since 2026-09-25 with no fix landed, and it is now failing essentially every post-commit ARM64 cross-compilation run regardless of the actual code change
prevention_strategies: Avoid re-configuring cmake on an already-built tree with different feature flags (TBB/WHEEL/CPACK_GENERATOR) while PCH is enabled; use a dedicated build directory per configuration, or explicitly purge PCH artifacts (cmake_pch.hxx.gch) whenever compiler-affecting options change between successive cmake invocations in the same directory.
historical_context: This exact signature has now recurred 14 times since 2026-09-25 (see pattern 0ee6d7327812b344), consistently on the ARM64 cross-compilation job's JS API build step, across many unrelated commits/PRs (including this one, which only touches documentation/skills) -- confirming this is a persistent infrastructure/build-script issue, not a code regression introduced by any single commit.
